edges.parent_basis:
The strongest edge on this line, because the act opens by reciting both of its
predecessors with their dates: `Postquam Apostolicis Litteris die XXII mensis
Februarii anno MCMIL et die VI Ianuarii MCML Motu Proprio datis matrimonii
disciplinae ordinandae et ecclesiasticis iudiciis componendis in Orientalibus
Ecclesiis consuluimus` -- having provided for the discipline of marriage and for
the composition of ecclesiastical trials by the two motu proprios of 22 February
1949 and 6 January 1950.
